title: 奧拉羅斯鹽湖鋰工程
summary: 以阿根廷高地鹵水與蒸發濃縮為案例，分開濃度、回收、季節及產品品質。 五組案例問題依序建立控制體、重算數值、檢查量測與診斷失效；計算參數是公開原理下的合成教學基準，並非該礦實際產能、設計條件或操作設定。
summaryEn: An Argentine highland brine and evaporation case separates concentration, recovery, seasonality and product quality. Five case investigations define boundaries, recalculate quantities, check measurements and diagnose failures. Numerical inputs are synthetic teaching benchmarks based on public principles, not the mine’s actual capacity, design conditions or operating settings.
scope: 本課以真實公開工程為情境，結合五個案例應用單元與五個明示共用的方法單元；原理與教學結構會跨課程重用。全部算例輸入均為合成教學假設，不代表場址實測、設計、保證或操作設定。任務為離線分析、守恆估算、資料檢核與失效推理，不是施工、開採、爆破、設備操作或作業許可。
scopeEn: Real public projects provide context for five case applications and five explicitly shared method units; physical methods and teaching structure are reused across courses. Every numerical input is a synthetic teaching assumption, not measured, design, guaranteed or operating data for the site. Tasks concern offline analysis, balances, data checking and failure reasoning, not construction, extraction, blasting, equipment operation or permits.
v31Focus: 進池鹵水與產品鋰量的獨立平衡；高地乾濕季蒸發面積需求；長時間濃縮流程的物料存量
v31FocusEn: Independent balance between pond-feed brine and product lithium; Highland wet/dry season evaporation-area demand; Material inventory in a long-residence concentration process

stages.title: 資源條件與系統邊界：奧拉羅斯鹽湖鋰工程
stages.titleEn: Resource conditions and system boundaries: Olaroz lithium operation
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「進池鹵水與產品鋰量的獨立平衡」與「高地乾濕季蒸發面積需求」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Independent balance between pond-feed brine and product lithium" and "Highland wet/dry season evaporation-area demand": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「進池鹵水與產品鋰量的獨立平衡」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Independent balance between pond-feed brine and product lithium" is correct?
options: 鹵水中的鋰質量由體積流量乘濃度得到，再乘分離回收率；濃縮倍數不等於鋰回收率。
鋰濃度提高十倍代表鋰產量也提高十倍。
年平均蒸發量足夠就表示每個月都不需要緩衝。
optionsEn: Lithium mass is brine volume flow times concentration times separation recovery; concentration factor is not lithium recovery.
Tenfold lithium concentration implies tenfold lithium production.
Adequate annual evaporation means no monthly buffer is needed.
quiz.explanation: 鹵水中的鋰質量由體積流量乘濃度得到，再乘分離回收率；濃縮倍數不等於鋰回收率。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Lithium mass is brine volume flow times concentration times separation recovery; concentration factor is not lithium recovery. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 進池鹵水與產品鋰量的獨立平衡：機制與資源流程
steps.titleEn: Independent balance between pond-feed brine and product lithium: mechanism and resource flow
steps.objective: 說明「進池鹵水與產品鋰量的獨立平衡」如何決定「奧拉羅斯鹽湖鋰工程」的物料、能量、量測或環境功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Independent balance between pond-feed brine and product lithium” governs material, energy, measurement or environmental functions in “Olaroz lithium operation”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 以「奧拉羅斯鹽湖鋰工程」作案例背景，本單元的原創桌上問題是「進池鹵水與產品鋰量的獨立平衡」。鹵水中的鋰質量由體積流量乘濃度得到，再乘分離回收率；濃縮倍數不等於鋰回收率。鹵水密度與溶解鹽影響體積基準，模型只計算元素鋰，不把它混稱為碳酸鋰當量或電池級產品。 這是情境分析，不宣稱該工程使用下列合成數值。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Using Olaroz lithium operation as the case setting, this original desk-based investigation addresses independent balance between pond-feed brine and product lithium. Lithium mass is brine volume flow times concentration times separation recovery; concentration factor is not lithium recovery. Density and dissolved salts affect the volume basis. The model reports elemental lithium, not lithium-carbonate equivalent or battery-grade product. This is scenario analysis and does not claim that the project uses the synthetic values below. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

quiz.question: 依「進池鹵水與產品鋰量的獨立平衡」的模型 M = Q·C·r/1000，鹵水鋰量守恆的合成教學算例；輸入單位：Q: m³/h brine; C: mg elemental Li/L; r: recovery fraction。不是該場址實測或操作值。最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model M = Q·C·r/1000 for "Independent balance between pond-feed brine and product lithium", which value is closest to the synthetic teaching example for lithium-in-brine mass balance; input units: Q: m³/h brine; C: mg elemental Li/L; r: recovery fraction. These are not measured or operating values for this site.?
options: 975 kg/h
optionsEn: 975 kg/h
quiz.explanation: M = Q·C·r/1000；代入 Q = 250 m³/h brine、C = 600 mg elemental Li/L、r = 0.65 recovery fraction，得 97.5 kg/h（鹵水鋰量守恆的合成教學算例；輸入單位：Q: m³/h brine; C: mg elemental Li/L; r: recovery fraction。不是該場址實測或操作值。）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: M = Q·C·r/1000; with Q = 250 m³/h brine, C = 600 mg elemental Li/L, r = 0.65 recovery fraction the result is 97.5 kg/h (synthetic teaching example for lithium-in-brine mass balance; input units: Q: m³/h brine; C: mg elemental Li/L; r: recovery fraction. These are not measured or operating values for this site.). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 進池鹵水與產品鋰量的獨立平衡：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Independent balance between pond-feed brine and product lithium: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「進池鹵水與產品鋰量的獨立平衡」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Independent balance between pond-feed brine and product lithium” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：M = Q·C·r/1000；代入 Q = 250 m³/h brine、C = 600 mg elemental Li/L、r = 0.65 recovery fraction，得 97.5 kg/h（鹵水鋰量守恆的合成教學算例；輸入單位：Q: m³/h brine; C: mg elemental Li/L; r: recovery fraction。不是該場址實測或操作值。）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 C 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: M = Q·C·r/1000; with Q = 250 m³/h brine, C = 600 mg elemental Li/L, r = 0.65 recovery fraction the result is 97.5 kg/h (synthetic teaching example for lithium-in-brine mass balance; input units: Q: m³/h brine; C: mg elemental Li/L; r: recovery fraction. These are not measured or operating values for this site.). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise C by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：C 增加 10% 時，結果變為 107 kg/h（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising C by 10% changes the result to 107 kg/h (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 97.5 kg/h（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 C 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 97.5 kg/h (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in C with an engineering explanation.

These are not measured or operating values for this site.).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: C 增加 10% 時，結果變為 107 kg/h（+10.0%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising C by 10% changes the result to 107 kg/h (+10.0%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are explicit synthetic teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「進池鹵水與產品鋰量的獨立平衡」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Independent balance between pond-feed brine and product lithium"?
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
物料帳有差額就能立即斷定有實體洩漏。
針對「進池鹵水與產品鋰量的獨立平衡」，用合成進出口濃度與流量核對鋰平衡，明示元素鋰與化合物當量；記錄溫度、密度及採樣時間。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Any balance residual immediately proves a physical leak.

For independent balance between pond-feed brine and product lithium, close a synthetic lithium balance using inlet/outlet concentration and flow, distinguish elemental lithium from compound equivalents, and record temperature, density and sampling time.
quiz.explanation: 針對「進池鹵水與產品鋰量的獨立平衡」，用合成進出口濃度與流量核對鋰平衡，明示元素鋰與化合物當量；記錄溫度、密度及採樣時間。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: For independent balance between pond-feed brine and product lithium, close a synthetic lithium balance using inlet/outlet concentration and flow, distinguish elemental lithium from compound equivalents, and record temperature, density and sampling time. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 進池鹵水與產品鋰量的獨立平衡：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Independent balance between pond-feed brine and product lithium: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「進池鹵水與產品鋰量的獨立平衡」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Independent balance between pond-feed brine and product lithium” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 針對「進池鹵水與產品鋰量的獨立平衡」，用合成進出口濃度與流量核對鋰平衡，明示元素鋰與化合物當量；記錄溫度、密度及採樣時間。 提交控制體圖與有單位的資料表，讓另一位學徒能獨立重算。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: For independent balance between pond-feed brine and product lithium, close a synthetic lithium balance using inlet/outlet concentration and flow, distinguish elemental lithium from compound equivalents, and record temperature, density and sampling time. Submit a control-volume diagram and a table with units so another learner can recalculate independently. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將取水與鹵水抽取分開呈現，質量模型不推論區域水文永續性。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Report fresh-water use separately from brine abstraction; the mass model does not establish regional hydrological sustainability.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：在「進池鹵水與產品鋰量的獨立平衡」情境，濃度升高但產量降低可能只是水分減少或回收損失；必須比較質量流而非只比較濃度。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: In the scenario of independent balance between pond-feed brine and product lithium, higher concentration with lower production can mean water removal or recovery loss; compare mass flow instead of concentration alone. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 在「進池鹵水與產品鋰量的獨立平衡」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Independent balance between pond-feed brine and product lithium" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 在「進池鹵水與產品鋰量的獨立平衡」情境，濃度升高但產量降低可能只是水分減少或回收損失；必須比較質量流而非只比較濃度。
所有異常都是操作人員失誤，設計、製造與維護不需要檢討。
年平均蒸發量足夠就表示每個月都不需要緩衝。
optionsEn: In the scenario of independent balance between pond-feed brine and product lithium, higher concentration with lower production can mean water removal or recovery loss.
Every anomaly is operator error, so design, manufacturing and maintenance never need review.
Adequate annual evaporation means no monthly buffer is needed.
quiz.explanation: 在「進池鹵水與產品鋰量的獨立平衡」情境，濃度升高但產量降低可能只是水分減少或回收損失；必須比較質量流而非只比較濃度。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: In the scenario of independent balance between pond-feed brine and product lithium, higher concentration with lower production can mean water removal or recovery loss; compare mass flow instead of concentration alone. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.titleEn: Independent balance between pond-feed brine and product lithium: failure diagnosis

Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, delivery, life or environment of “Olaroz lithium operation”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這是情境分析，不宣稱該工程使用下列合成數值。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: This is scenario analysis and does not claim that the project uses the synthetic values below.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「年平均蒸發量足夠就表示每個月都不需要緩衝。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adequate annual evaporation means no monthly buffer is needed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 在「高地乾濕季蒸發面積需求」情境，全年水量平衡卻在雨季積水，通常來自季節調蓄未列入；另需區分降雨與滲漏造成的濃度變化。 記錄哪一項獨立資料能排除替代原因。
knowledge.textEn: In the scenario of highland wet/dry season evaporation-area demand, annual balance with wet-season accumulation usually reflects omitted seasonal storage; distinguish rainfall from leakage when interpreting concentration changes. Record which independent observation rules out an alternative cause.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

knowledge.text: 2026-11-10：核對官方工程識別與公開情境；算例由作者設定為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: 2026-11-10: Primary project identity and public context reviewed; numerical examples are authored teaching assumptions.
